title: Midwest Battle of the Rims: Thanksgiving Throwdown
seo_title: Midwest Battle of the Rims: Thanksgiving Throwdown
description: Midwest Battle of the Rims: Thanksgiving Throwdown is a holiday event taking place on November 14, 2026, with the time to be determined. It will be held at Fieldhouse Sportscenter, 2235 W. Kingsley St., in Springfield, MO. The event is open to a general audience.
